strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Logiciel yeeyde e nder oto e yeeyooɓe laawol
strings.tierB.home.description: Logiciel distributeur'en: facture e reçu e telefon yeeyoowo, stock oto, rentinde kaalis, laabi e yillaaje. Ina golla tawa internet alaa, ina neldoo caggal.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Toppitee yeeyooɓe mon e laawol, gila yillaare adannde haa rentinde kaalis sakkitiinde
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ko platform cloud ngam kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis e grossiste'en jogiiɗi yeeyooɓe golloowooɓe e laawol. Yeeyoowo kala ina waɗa facture e reçu e telefon mum, ina imprimer ɗum, ina jokka stock oto mum, ina winnda yillaaje mum; hooreeɓe ɓee ina njiya njeeygu, kaalis rentinaangal e ñamaande kiliyaaɓe ɓee e oon sahaa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Facture e telefon yeeyoowo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Yeeyoowo oo ina waɗa facture e dammbugal bitik kiliyaa oo, ina imprimer nde e imprimante thermique Bluetooth hade makko yaltude bitik oo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Rentinde kaalis e ñamaande kiliyaaɓe
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Njoɓdi kala ina heɓa reçu mo limoore, mo jokkondiri e facture ɗe kiliyaa oo yoɓi. Ñamaande kiliyaa oo e relevé makko ina kesitinee ɗon e ɗon.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Stock oto mo yeeyoowo halfinaa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stock oto kala ina jokkee marsandiis e marsandiis: ko loowaa, ko yeeyaa, ko ruttaa e ko heddii, ngam luutndaare kala feeña e ñalnde nden.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Laabi e yillaaje
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Yillaaje ɗee ina mbinndee e nokku, waktu e nataale, laawol yeeyoowo kala ina natee e karte ngam hooreejo oo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ina golla tawa internet alaa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Yeeyooɓe ɓee ina njokka yeeyde hay so réseau alaa. Kayitaaji ɗii ina heddoo e telefon; so connexion ruttike, kala kayit ina yaha e serveur oo hoore mum, laawol gootol tan.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Tableau de bord web ngam hooreeɓe
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Njeeygu, rentinde kaalis, ko ruttaa, stock e no yeeyoowo kala golliri e nokku gooto, e rôle e autorisation ngam huutortooɗo kala.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Wiyee min no njeeyirton
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Ɗaɓɓee devis walla waɗee rendez-vous. Min ndaarat yeeyooɓe mon, laabi mon, marsandiis mon e ko facture mon sokli.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Moƴƴinee kompanii mon
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Naatnee marsandiis, coggu, kiliyaaɓe e yeeyooɓe, suɓee kadi kaalis leydi mon e lempo mon e paramètres.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Neldee yeeyooɓe e laawol
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Yeeyoowo kala ina installer application nde e Android walla iPhone, ina loowa marsandiis e oto mum, refti o fuɗɗa yeeyde, imprimer e rentinde kaalis.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Jokkee golle ñalnde nden e oon sahaa
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Tableau de bord web oo ina hollira njeeygu, rentinde kaalis, stock oto e yillaaje tawa yeeyooɓe ɓee ina e laawol tawo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ko platform cloud ngam toppitaade yeeyooɓe golloowooɓe e laawol e nder kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis e grossiste'en. Ina toppitoo yeeyde e nder oto (van sales), yeeyde e laabi tabitinaaɗi (route sales), ƴettude commande hade addude (pre-sales) e addude marsandiis haa e bitik (DSD). Yeeyoowo kala ina waɗa facture, ina imprimer, ina rentina kaalis, ina winnda yillaaje e telefon mum; hooreeɓe ɓee ina njokka njeeygu, rentinde kaalis, stock oto e ñamaande kiliyaaɓe e tableau de bord web.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: Hol FieldSales ina golla tawa internet alaa?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Eey. Application yeeyoowo ina jokka golle tawa internet alaa: yeeyoowo ina waɗa facture e reçu, ina imprimer, ina winnda yillaaje, ina ɓeyda kiliyaaɓe kesuɓe; so connexion ruttike, kala ko waɗaa ina yaha e serveur oo hoore mum, laawol gootol tan. Ina woodi exception wootere e Arabi Sawdit: kompaniiji udditɗi jokkondiral facture électronique ina sokli connexion e sahaa nde facture walla retour yaltinetee.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales ina golloo kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis e leyɗe fof. Kompanii kala ina suɓa kaalis leydi mum e lempo mum e paramètres mum, facture, reçu e rapport ina kuutoroo ɗum. Siège FieldSales ina woni Riyaad, Arabi Sawdit, fuɗɗoode golle ina waɗee e internet: rendez-vous, WhatsApp e ballal gila ka woɗɗi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Hol FieldSales ina jokkondira e sistemuuji facture électronique laamu?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Min ina mbaawi jokkondiral Phase ɗiɗaɓo e platform Fatoora mo ZATCA. Ɗum ina fawii tan e kompaniiji ɗi ngoni Arabi Sawdit. E leyɗe goɗɗe, FieldSales ina yaltina facture e kaalis mon e lempo mon; jokkondiral e sistem facture électronique leydi ina heɓoo so ɗaɓɓaama, caggal nde min ndaarnoo e mon ko leydi ndii sokli. Min fodataa kawrugol e sarɗiiji leyɗe goɗɗe ka yaasi Arabi Sawdit.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: E ɗemɗe honɗe application FieldSales ina heɓoo?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Interface application FieldSales ina heɓoo e ɗemɗe ɗee tan: Aarabeere, Engeleere, Farayseere, Turkeere e Siineere. Interface Pulaar alaa, kono Farayseere e Engeleere ina e majje. Yeeyooɓe e hooreeɓe ina mbaawi waylude ɗemngal interface oo, facture imprimaande ina waawi jogaade ɗemngal goɗngal takko ɗemngal mawngal ngal. Kelle web e ɗemɗe goɗɗe, wano hello Pulaar ngoo, ko firooji ngam rokkude kabaruuji baɗte FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Ɗaɓɓee devis, waɗee rendez-vous walla neldee min bataake e WhatsApp. Min ndaarat no yeeyooɓe mon ngollirta, refti min mballa on moƴƴinde marsandiis, coggu, kiliyaaɓe e yeeyooɓe. Yeeyooɓe ina installer application nde e Android walla iPhone, hooreeɓe ina kuutoroo tableau de bord web e navigateur kala. Smartphone tan woni ko on sokli e kaɓirɗe.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Interface application FieldSales ina heɓoo e ɗemɗe ɗee: Aarabeere, Engeleere, Farayseere, Turkeere e Siineere; Pulaar alaa e majje. Kelle e ɗemɗe goɗɗe ina cifa FieldSales ngam kabaru tan.
strings.tierB.category.title: Logiciel Yeeyde e Nder Oto (Vente en Tournée) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Logiciel yeeyde e nder oto e e laabi: facture imprimaande e telefon, stock oto marsandiis e marsandiis, rentinde kaalis e yillaaje, tawa internet alaa.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Logiciel yeeyde e nder oto ngam distributeur'en e grossiste'en
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ko logiciel yeeyde e nder oto (vente en tournée, van sales) ngam kompaniiji ɗi yeeyooɓe majji njeeyata e nder oto e laabi ñalnde kala. Yeeyoowo oo ina loowa oto oo, ina yeeya e bitik kala, ina imprimer facture, ina rentina kaalis, ina winnda ko ruttaa, kala ɗum e application wootere e telefon. Hooreejo oo ina yiya ko loowaa, ko yeeyaa, ko rentinaa e ko heddii e oto kala.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Ko honɗum woni logiciel yeeyde e nder oto?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Logiciel yeeyde e nder oto, mo noddirtee kadi cash van walla route sales, ina toppitoo mbaadi njeeygu nde yeeyoowo oo jogii marsandiis e nder oto, o yeeya, o adda, o waɗa facture, o rentina kaalis e yillaare wootere. Ina lomtoo defte facture winndaaɗe junngo e noddaaje telefon kiikiiɗe. Ina winnda njeeygu kala, njoɓdi kala e retour kala wano kayitaaji, ngam stock e kaalis mbaawa fondondireede e ñalnde nden. Ngam hooreejo oo, ina jaabtoo naamne tati jemma kala: ko yeeyoowo kala yeeyi, hol no foti ko o rentini, e ko heddii e nder oto kala.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Ñalnde wootere e laawol
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Ñalnde nden ina fuɗɗoo e loowgol winndaangol gila e dépôt haa e oto. E bitik kala yeeyoowo oo ina uddita fiche kiliyaa oo, ina naatna marsandiis gila e liste walla code-barre, ina yaltina facture, ina imprimer nde e imprimante thermique. Njoɓdi ina winndee e reçu, retour kala ina winndee e sabaabu mum. E kiikiiɗe, ko heddii e oto oo ina jippinee, ina ruttee e dépôt. Hakkunde ɗeeɗoo golle, hooreejo oo ina waawi jokkude njeeygu, rentinde kaalis e yillaaje yeeyoowo kala e tableau de bord web, tawa o noddaani hay gooto.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Mahaa ngam nokkuuji ɗi réseau saɗi
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Laabi senndugol marsandiis ina njaha e nder sous-sol, zones industrielles e gure ɗe réseau saɗi. Application yeeyoowo FieldSales ina mooftoo kiliyaaɓe, marsandiis e coggu e telefon, ngam yeeyoowo oo waawa yaltinde e imprimer kayitaaji tawa internet alaa. Kayit kala ina jogii coktirgal mum tan, ngam ɗum naata e serveur oo laawol gootol tan, hay so neldugol ngol fuɗɗitaama laabi keewɗi. Kompaniiji Arabi Sawdit udditɗi jokkondiral facture électronique ina sokli connexion e sahaa nde facture e retour yaltinetee. Kono ngam majji kadi, reçu, yillaaje e kiliyaaɓe kesuɓe ina golla tawa internet alaa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Rentinde kaalis e stock oto halfinaaɗo
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Kaalis ngal woni e laawol ina sokli ndeenka hono stock. Kaalis rentinaangal kala ina heɓa reçu mo limoore, mo waawi jokkondireede e facture ɗe kiliyaa oo yoɓi, ñamaande heddiinde kiliyaa oo ina kesitinee ɗon e ɗon. Stock oto ina limee marsandiis e marsandiis: ko loowaa, ittaa ko yeeyaa, ɓeydaa retour e ajustements winndaaɗe, ngam hooreeɓe mbaawa fondude ɗum e limoore e junngo hade yeeyoowo oo hootaade. Retour ina waawi senndeede: normal, bonɗo walla échange, hooreejo oo ina taƴa so marsandiis ruttaaɗo oo ina rutta e stock oto mo yeeyetee.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ko ngam moy?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ina moƴƴi ngam distributeur'en e grossiste'en marsandiis yaawɗi yeeyeede wano ñaamdu, njaram, marsandiis laɓɓinirɗe e marsandiis ngam toppitaade ɓalli, e kompanii kala jogiiɗo yeeyooɓe yillotooɓe bitikuuji e laabi. Ina toppitoo yeeyde e nder oto, ƴettude commande hade addude e addude marsandiis haa e bitik. Wonaa ERP timmuɗo: ina jokkondira e logiciel comptabilité mon walla ERP rewrude e API. Ko hooreeɓe ɓee taƴata ko yeeyoowo kala waawi waɗde, wano rokkude ustaare coggu, yeeyde ko les coggu liste walla ɓeydude kiliyaaɓe kesuɓe.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Ko honɗum woni luutndaare hakkunde yeeyde e nder oto e ƴettude commande hade addude?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: E yeeyde e nder oto, yeeyoowo oo ina jogii marsandiis, ina adda ɗum, ina waɗa facture, ina rentina kaalis e yillaare wootere. E ƴettude commande hade addude (pre-sales), yeeyoowo oo ina ƴetta commande nde dépôt oo addata caggal ɗum. FieldSales ina toppitoo ɗiɗi ɗii fof, ngam kompanii ina waawi huutoraade cash van e laabi seeɗa, e ƴettude commande e laabi goɗɗi. E mbaadiiji ɗiɗi ɗii, facture, rentinde kaalis e ñamaande kiliyaaɓe ina ngoni e sistem gooto, hooreeɓe ina njiya ɗum e rapport gooto.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: No mbaawirmi fondude stock oto e kiikiiɗe?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales ina hollira, ngam marsandiis kala e oto kala, ko loowaa, ko yeeyaa, ko ruttaa e ko heddii. Fondee ko heddii e limoore e junngo, winndee luutndaare kala wano ajustement winndaaɗo, refti jippinee ko heddii, ruttee ɗum e dépôt e mouvement gooto. Oto oo ina fuɗɗoo jaŋngo e solde laaɓɗo, anndaaɗo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Kaɓirɗe honɗe yeeyoowo e nder oto sokli?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android walla iPhone. Imprimante thermique Bluetooth wonaa ko waajibi, kono ina newnana yeeyoowo oo rokkude kiliyaa oo facture walla reçu imprimaaɗo. FieldSales yeeyataa kaɓirɗe, waajibinaa kadi marque imprimante wootere. Hooreeɓe ina kuutoroo tableau de bord web e navigateur ordinateur walla telefon kala.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Hol FieldSales ina waawi jokkondiraade e logiciel comptabilité amen?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Eey. FieldSales ina jogii API mo newnanta logiciel comptabilité mon walla ERP lomtondirde e platform oo kiliyaaɓe, marsandiis, facture, reçu e mouvements stock. Fedde mon walla intégrateur mon woni mahoowo jokkondiral ngal e kuutorgol kayitaaji API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales e Leyɗe: Kaalis, Lempo e Facture Électronique
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales ina golloo distributeur'en e leyɗe fof. Ndaaree kaalis, lempo e no facture électronique woniri e leydi kala e tabal gootal.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales ina golloo kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis e leyɗe fof. Kompanii kala ina suɓa leydi mum, kaalis mum e lempo mum e paramètres mum, facture, reçu e rapport ina njokka ɗum. Jokkondiral facture électronique laamu ina golla e Arabi Sawdit tan. E leyɗe goɗɗe fof, ina heɓoo so ɗaɓɓaama. Tabal ngal les ina hollira, ngam leydi kala, kaalis leydi ndii, lempo njeeygu walla TVA mo woowaa, e so jokkondiral facture électronique laamu ina golla walla ina heɓoo so ɗaɓɓaama.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Min ina mbaawi jokkondiral Phase ɗiɗaɓo e platform Fatoora mo ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Kompanii kala ina suɓa kaalis e lempo e paramètres mum. Lempooji ɗi ngoni e ngal tabal ko kabaruuji kuuɓɗi, ina mbaawi waylude; ndaaree sarɗiiji jooni ɗii e ballotooɗo mon e lempo. Maandel (—) ina firta wonde lempo kuuɓal winndaaka ngam leydi ndii.
strings.tierB.about.title: Baɗte FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales ina maha logiciel cloud ngam kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis jogiiɗi yeeyooɓe e laawol. Sosaa ko e 2026 e Riyaad, Arabi Sawdit.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (innde mum e Aarabeere ko فيلد سيلز) ko platform cloud ngam kompaniiji senndooji marsandiis e grossiste'en jogiiɗi yeeyooɓe golloowooɓe e laawol. FieldSales sosaa ko e 2026, siège mum ina woni Riyaad, Arabi Sawdit. Ina golloo kompaniiji e leyɗe fof, kompanii kala ina suɓa kaalis e lempo leydi mum e paramètres mum. Kiliyaaɓe amen ko kompaniiji yeeyooji, addooji marsandiis rewrude e yeeyooɓe e laawol: distributeur'en, grossiste'en e usineeji jogiiɗi otooji njeeygu majji.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Min ina maha sistem gooto jokkondirɗo ngam golle laawol fof: facture imprimaaɗe e telefon yeeyoowo, reçu e ñamaande kiliyaaɓe, stock oto mo yeeyoowo halfinaa, laabi e yillaaje e nokku e nataale, e tableau de bord web ngam hooreeɓe. Application yeeyoowo ina golla e Android e iPhone, ina jokka golle tawa internet alaa, refti ina neldoo kala ko waɗaa so connexion ruttike. Kompaniiji ina mbaawi jokkondirde FieldSales e logiciel comptabilité maɓɓe walla ERP rewrude e API, ngam kabaruuji laawol ɗii winndetaake laabi ɗiɗi.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Min ina cifa ko min ngaɗata no woniri. Min ina mbaawi jokkondiral Phase ɗiɗaɓo e platform Fatoora mo ZATCA. Jokkondiral e sistemuuji laamu e leyɗe goɗɗe ina heɓoo so ɗaɓɓaama. Interface application nde ina heɓoo e ɗemɗe ɗee: Aarabeere, Engeleere, Farayseere, Turkeere e Siineere; Pulaar alaa e majje. Ngam haaldude e amen, ɗaɓɓee devis, waɗee rendez-vous walla neldee min bataake e WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Jokkondiree e FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Haaldee e fedde FieldSales: ɗaɓɓee devis, waɗee rendez-vous walla haaldee e amen e WhatsApp baɗte logiciel yeeyooɓe e laawol e yeeyde e nder oto.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Wiyee min no yeeyooɓe mon njeeyirta hannde e ko njiɗon waylude. Ɗaɓɓee devis, waɗee rendez-vous walla neldee bataake e WhatsApp, gooto e fedde amen jaabtoto on. Kiliyaaɓe amen jooni ɓee ina mbaawi huutoraade ɗii laabi ngam ballal. Ina wallata min so on innii leydi mon, limoore yeeyooɓe mon, e so ɓe njeeyata e nder oto, ina ƴetta commande, walla ɗum ɗiɗi fof.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Waɗee rendez-vous ngam batu e internet e fedde amen. Min kollat on ñalnde yeeyoowo e nder application nde e tableau de bord hooreejo oo, e misalaaji ɓadiiɗi e marsandiis mon e laabi mon, min njaabta kadi naamne mon baɗte moƴƴinde golle.
